algorithms.name: 多层感知机（MLP）
algorithms.description: 支持分类和回归的全连接神经网络
algorithms.pythonCodeTemplate:
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier, MLPRegressor
hidden_size = int(params.pop('hidden_layer_size', 100))
hidden_layers = int(params.pop('hidden_layers', 2))
params['hidden_layer_sizes'] = tuple([hidden_size] * hidden_layers)
params.setdefault('random_state', 42)
model_cls = MLPClassifier if _model_type == 'classification' else MLPRegressor
clf = model_cls(**params)
